_comment: The front door prototype's numbers (docs/design/front-door.md, sections 3 and 5). card_min_px is the narrowest an update card may be before the row drops a card; it was chosen by the measurement in section 3 (the last 100 release headlines, measured at each width in the page's own font). Below two cards side by side the row becomes a swipe row of card_max cards. chat_lines is how many posts the read-only chat slice shows, chat_lines_narrow on a phone. hold_minutes is the proposed wait before a chat post may show on the front page.
